name: The Romance Theorem
source:
A non-linear narrative game examining fragments of a relationship. Either stay together forever, or don't - it's all up to you.

[From [url=https://arrozdesigns.itch.io/the-romance-theorem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一种检查关系片段的非线性叙事游戏。要么永远在一起，要么不在一起——这一切都取决于你。

[来自[url=https://arrozdesigns.itch.io/the-romance-theorem]Itch.io[/url]]
